resources.string: Tints reposts, quotes, replies and reactions so they are easier to tell apart. Default is off (monochrome).
Pick background, text and accent colors. The rest (surfaces, borders, secondary text) is derived automatically.
Search by theme or author name
Publish these colors as a theme so others can find and use them. Publishing again with the same name updates it.
To publish your own theme, use "Publish to theme store" on the Customize tab.
Themes published by others (NIP-78). Tap one to preview it, then tap Apply. Themes made for a newer app version are marked — you can still apply them.
No themes found yet. Publish yours from the Customize tab, or import a share code below.
Preview — nothing changes until you tap Apply.
This is a sample post. Check how your colors look here.
Low accent contrast (%1$s:1). Buttons and links may be hard to see — 3:1 or higher is recommended.
Connect a Lightning wallet via Nostr Wallet Connect (NIP-47) to complete Zaps inside the app. Every payment asks for confirmation.
Get a connection string from your wallet (e.g. Alby Hub, Coinos). The secret is stored in this device’s secure storage.
The saved connection (including its secret) is removed from this device.
Pays in-app from your connected wallet (asks every time).
Low contrast (%1$s:1). Text may be hard to read — 4.5:1 or higher is recommended.
Overall size of text, icons, and spacing.
Show links in posts as cards and thumbnails. Turn off to save data.
Show preview cards for other links
Tap to add to your list (already-added ones are hidden). Adding does not connect immediately.
Relays popular among people you follow
None selected = fetch from all relays
Toggle public/private and press Save to republish. Unchecking both removes the entry.
Some private entries could not be decrypted, so editing is disabled (to avoid overwriting them).
Image upload servers (NIP-96 / auth via NIP-98)
Images attached to a post are uploaded to the selected server.

When posting, "Low/Mid" images are resized to the max long edge below and re-encoded (Android=WebP, iOS=JPEG). "High" always uploads the original. Defaults: Low=640px, Mid=1200px, Quality=85%. Ranges: 128–8192px / 30–100%.

Videos are transcoded to H.264/mp4 at the heights below when "Low/Mid" is selected ("High" keeps the original). Defaults: Low=480p, Mid=720p. Range: 240–2160p. On iOS the value is rounded to the nearest standard preset (480/540/720/1080p).
Tap ♡ on a post to favorite it.
Add one from a post’s ⋯ menu → “Bookmark”.
DMs from others arrive at the relays declared here. A few dedicated relays are recommended for privacy. If unset, they are created from your read relays on first send.
Aggregating DM relays (kind:10050) used by people you follow…
Relays your follows use for DMs
Could not aggregate (no follows, or nobody publishes kind:10050).
Saving publishes kind:0. Existing custom fields are preserved.
Couldn't load your current profile yet. Only the fields you change will be published.
Choose the shape of the reaction button on posts; pressing it sends this. (You can always pick other emoji from the emoji picker.)

Manually saves your settings and deck layout to relays as kind:30078 (NIP-78). Loading fetches your latest snapshot and shows a per-item diff so you can choose what to apply. Nothing is synced automatically.
Publishes two events (settings and deck layout, kind:30078) to your write relays, replacing the previous snapshots.
No saved data found on relays.
Only checked items will be applied.
Clears all locally cached data (timeline history, profiles, channels, pending posts) and refetches from relays. Keys, relay settings, and hashtag history are kept.
Deletes all stored events, profiles, channels, and pending posts, then refetches from relays. Keys and relay settings are kept. This cannot be undone.
Choose a login method. We never generate a key without asking. If you don’t have an account yet, create a new key under “Private key”.
Log in with a different account
Choose a login method. Only methods available on this device are shown.
This switches the current login. Continuing clears locally cached data (timeline history, profiles, etc.). A local key cannot be recovered without its backup (nsec).
Removes the login from this device. A local key (nsec) is erased and cannot be recovered without a backup. External signing (Amber / remote / passkey) connections are also removed.
Shows the private key (nsec) stored on this device so you can write it down. It cannot be recovered if lost.
Encrypts your private key with a passkey (biometrics) using WebAuthn PRF.
Registration failed (no PRF support / cancelled / domain not linked)
Passkey protection can be set while using a local key.
Connects to a signing app (Amber etc.) or a bunker. Your private key stays on the remote signer.
Paste this connection link in your signing app (“paste from clipboard”) and approve:
Log in with an external signing app
Signs with %1$s so your private key never enters this app (NIP-55).
Read = Inbox (fetch things addressed to you; stays connected) / Write = Outbox (where your posts go). Edit the checkboxes and press Save to publish kind:10002.
Authentication needed to receive DMs etc. from AUTH-required relays. Responding proves your public key to that relay.
Aggregating relay lists (NIP-65) of people you follow…
Could not aggregate (no follows etc.). Popular picks:
%1$s It will be removed from the list and reflected in the next published kind:10002.
Signs the current Read/Write settings as kind:10002 and publishes to your Write relays and connected relays. This is a public action.
Log in with a private key (nsec)
Import an nsec or generate a new key. The imported key is stored on this device.
Enter a private key starting with nsec1… (your input starts with: %1$s). Use “Show” to check that autofill didn’t insert something else.
All data tied to the current account — follows, relay list (NIP-65), timeline history, profile cache — is discarded and reloaded with the new key. This cannot be undone.
Anyone who knows your private key (nsec) has full control of your account. Beware of shoulder surfing, and make sure it won’t appear in screenshots, screen recording, or screen sharing.
Store it somewhere safe such as a password manager. If you copy it, it may also remain in clipboard history or sync.
Posting failed. Your attachments are kept — please try again.
The text and attached images will not be saved.
Can’t change the mute list (it may be locked)
Publishes a deletion event (kind:5) to remove the reaction. Some relays may not honor deletions.
Their posts and notifications will be hidden. You can undo anytime in Settings → Mute.
Send sats to %1$s. Choose an amount and pay with your wallet.
Couldn’t get an invoice. Check lud16 / relay settings.
This list has private entries that only its owner can read.
Their posts will appear in your timeline again.
Their posts will no longer appear in your timeline. Mutes are stored privately (NIP-51).
Only what could be observed on relays (not the total).
Add words / #tags to search (multiple conditions are OR-ed)
Couldn’t save your profile. Check your login/signing and try again.
Your custom emoji list (NIP-51). These appear in the reaction picker and can be used in posts as :shortcode:. Emoji from subscribed emoji sets are managed separately and not shown here.
No custom emoji yet. Add one below.
Could not publish the emoji list.
Creates a public chat thread (NIP-28). Anyone can find and join it.
Could not upload the attachment. Check your upload server in Settings → Media servers.
Could not upload the image. Check your upload server in Settings → Media servers.
Publishes a deletion event (kind:5). Relays are not required to honor it, and clients that already have the post may keep showing it. It will disappear from this device.
Publishes a deletion event (kind:5). Relays are not required to honor it, and people who already applied the theme keep it. It will disappear from this device.
Makes all text one step heavier. Helps readability on low-contrast themes.
A just-for-fun cat mode: cat ears on avatars and "nya-ized" text (na → nya). Display-only on this device — your actual posts are never changed.
Hide the URL text when a card is shown
Adds "View event JSON" to the post and chat menus, so you can inspect the raw event of anything on your timeline.
Up to %1$d pinned tags. Tidy them up in the hashtag manager.

Pinned tags (NIP-51 kind:30015) always show as chips in the composer and the hashtag column dialog, and sync across devices. Tags you have used are remembered on this device and suggested when you type #.
Long-press and drag to reorder. The order here is the order of the chips.

Tags can only contain letters, digits and _.
